title: Why re:cinq Sponsored AI DevCon — And Will Again
description:
A silver sponsorship that turned a booth conversation into a customer. re:cinq has sponsored plenty of events this year — AI DevCon was the one where people showed up already adopting AI hands-on, not planning to look into it in three years.

Here's what made the crowd different, and why they're already committed to coming back.

What we cover:
– Why the engagement felt different from the other events re:cinq sponsored this year
– What changes when attendees are adopting AI hands-on rather than theoretically
– Driving people from the talk to the booth, and the book signings that kept them there
– Why the meetups and community work were the reason re:cinq sponsored in the first place
– Content, people and conversations: what re:cinq actually measures a sponsorship by
